title: BULLKpy: an AnnData-based framework for bulk transcriptomic analysis
description: BULLKpy is a Scanpy-style Python framework for bulk RNA-seq and other bulk omics data. A cohort is kept in one AnnData object (samples x genes, with clinical metadata in .obs) and analysed with preprocessing, tools, plotting and accessor modules: quality control, normalisation, PCA/UMAP, clustering, differential expression, preranked GSEA, gene-signature scoring, metaprogram heterogeneity, association screens and Cox survival models.
